definitions.explanation: Material used for constructing or covering floors, such as wood, tile, vinyl, or carpet.

examples.japanese: {床材|ゆかざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦{無垢|むく}→無垢：13421_muku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{床材|ゆかざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Solid wood flooring has warmth to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{床材|ゆかざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦フローリング→フローリング：11125_furooringu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: During the renovation, we decided to change the flooring from hardwood to tatami.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧ (floor) and ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material). Commonly encountered in home building, renovation, and interior design contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床材|ゆかざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: types of flooring material
- {床材|ゆかざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to lay flooring
- {床材|ゆかざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}える→張り替える：28418_harikaeru⟧: to replace flooring
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{木|もく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{床材|ゆかざい}: natural wood flooring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦フローリング→フローリング：11125_furooringu⟧: flooring — specifically refers to wooden floor covering; also used generically
- ⟦{床板|ゆかいた}→床板：25464_yukaita⟧: floorboard — the individual boards making up a wooden floor
- ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧: tatami — traditional Japanese straw mat flooring
